The '''1993–94 [[La Liga]]''' season was the 63rd since its establishment. It began on 4 September 1993, and concluded on 15 May 1994. The league was won by [[FC Barcelona|Barcelona]] for the fourth consecutive season, and the fourteenth time overall.
